opening.argument: The promotional claims are direct and unusually strong. The title advertises a DeFi bot with "+100% Profit Per Day," while the description directs viewers to "Download►►https://bit.ly/SoftwareProx." The speaker then presents a $500 investment, an 80% target, pre-launch scanning, and a reported example in which "we've made around 90% profit." The accompanying claim that users can "always make realistic and repeatable gains" reinforces the promised-return framing, and the displayed "INVESTED: $500" entry and account balances provide visual support without independently verifying any profit. The description does acknowledge that the bot can stop after a sharp token decline, but that qualification does not remove the central promotion of automated trading returns, including a chart labeled 10X FROM BUY.
